pattern: IM-T04 invoice exceeds the approved scope: landlord approved a new handle; contractor added extra handles, stays and resealing at the tenant's request, GBP 348.00 incl. VAT
notes: Family 044-iu, variant v06. Same as v05 up to event 023. 024 (Wed 12 Feb 14:38): Cedar Homes resend the invoice (attachment-01-invoice.pdf: CH-2292, handle work GBP 60 as in v05, plus two bedroom handles GBP 40, landing window friction stays GBP 65, extra labour GBP 90, resealing GBP 35; subtotal GBP 290, VAT GBP 58, total GBP 348.00), saying the tenant asked for the extras on site. 025 (Thu 13 Feb 08:12): the tenant confirms the handle and mentions the bedroom handles. History truncated after 025. Expected: the approved part (handle, GBP 72 incl. VAT) is fine; the extras (GBP 276 incl. VAT) were never put to the landlord. Ask the landlord whether he accepts the additional work, with the itemised split; tell Cedar Homes the extras were not authorised and are on hold pending the landlord; do not pay the whole invoice, do not charge the tenant (Tenant Fees Act), do not close. Escalation is acceptable but the landlord can decide. Total events 25, marker set to event 026.
